verdict.rationale: Mercury documents free savings accounts and up to 3.89% yield through Treasury by Mercury Advisory, and its API supports internal transfers between checking/savings and treasury accounts. A long-time customer reports running dozens of purpose-named accounts with auto-funding rules, which suggests built-in automated transfers. However, no first-party documentation describes those transfer rules, and the savings account itself is not stated to be high-yield (the yield comes from Treasury). missing for 10: first-party docs for automated transfer/auto-funding rules (triggers, schedules, thresholds), explicit high-yield rate on the savings sub-account, independent corroboration beyond a single community anecdote.
